1.name: Crusader Strike
1.description: Strike your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 4 (L8) Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60).
1.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–4 Holy dmg (L1–L8) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, drawing their attention. This ability has additional effects in PvP. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

1.name: Poison Protection
1.description: Ward yourself against toxins, increasing your Poison Resistance by 5 for 35 minutes.

2.name: Aura of Courage
2.description: Envelop your group in a courageous aura, increasing their Armor Class by 1 (L1) to 30 (L60) and resistance to Fear effects by 20%. Additionally, your Block skill is increased by 5 and Threat generated by 10% while emanating this Aura. This ability persists until canceled.

2.name: Conviction
2.description: Become consumed by conviction, increasing your Strength, Wisdom, and Stamina by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60) as well as your Mana Regeneration by 1 (L1) to 4 (L60).

3.name: Cure Disease
3.description: Cure your target, removing one Disease effect.

3.name: Shield Slam
3.description: Fiercely bash your target with a shield, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds. (requires shield)

4.name: Cudgel of Light
4.description: Strike your target with divine energy, dealing 5 (L4) to 8 (L8) Holy Damage.

5.name: Lesser Pacify
5.description: Pacify your target, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. This spell has additional effects in PvP. This spell is limited to one target. This spell is limited to targets up to level 24.

6.name: Invisibility versus Undead
6.description: Shroud a target party member in darkness, rendering them unseen by undead for 10 minutes. This spell has a moderate chance to end early.

7.name: Shield Toss
7.description: Toss a holy shield that ricochets between your target and those around it, interrupting their casting. (requires shield)

8.name: Crusader Strike II
8.description: Strike your target, dealing 105% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 4 (L8) to 8 (L21) Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60).
8.valuesSummary: 105% weapon dmg · 4–8 Holy dmg (L8–L21) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

8.name: Lay on Hands
8.description: Heal your target with a holy touch, restoring 99 (L1) to 3840 (L60) Health.

8.name: Fear the Dead
8.description: Fear a target undead, causing them to flee for 18 seconds. This spell has a slight chance to be removed by damage.

9.name: Blind
9.description: Shroud the vision of your target, blinding them for 12 seconds.

10.name: Cure Poison
10.description: Cure your target, removing one Poison effect.

10.name: Restorative Smite
10.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 5 (L10) Holy Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60), and restoring 10 (L10) to 40 (L60) Health to your group. When standing upon Consecrated ground, the health restored is increased to 30 (L10) to 120 (L60).
10.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–5 Holy dmg (L1–L10) · +30–300 Threat against them (L1–L60)

11.name: Disease Protection
11.description: Ward yourself against sickness, increasing your Disease Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

12.name: Hallowed Ground
12.description: Consecrate the ground at your feet, granting allies 5 (L12) to 20 (L42) Corruption Resistance. Additionally, your Smite and Restorative Smite abilities will be empowered while you remain in the blessed area.

12.name: Repel the Dead
12.description: Repel a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 30 Holy Damage.

12.name: Vengeful Smite
12.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L12) to 10 (L22) Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60). The Holy damage is doubled when standing within a Consecration.
12.valuesSummary: 150% weapon dmg · 1–10 Holy dmg (L12–L22) · +30–300 Threat against them (L1–L60)

14.name: Aura of Piety
14.description: Envelop your group in a pious aura, increasing all incoming healing by 10%. This ability persists until canceled.

14.name: Snare the Dead
14.description: Bind a target undead with holy chains, decreasing their Movement Speed by 50% for 30 seconds.

15.name: Unleash the Light
15.description: Unleash a blinding light on targets in a frontal cone, incapacitating them for 6 seconds. This ability is removed by damage.

16.name: Gavel of Light
16.description: Strike your target with divine energy, dealing 70 Holy Damage.

16.name: Reanimation
16.description: Reanimate a target corpse, restoring 15% Experience. This spell inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes.

16.name: Mark of the Crusader
16.description: Brand your target with the mark of the crusader, removing one Damage Shield effect and causing melee attacks to activate Crusader's Mark for 30 seconds. Crusader's Mark: Weakly heal your wounds, restoring 1 (L1) to 6 (L60) Health.

18.name: Root
18.description: Root your target to the ground, immobilizing them for 30 seconds. This spell has a chance to be removed by damage. This spell has a very strong chance to end early.

19.name: Pacify
19.description: Pacify your target, reducing their Aggro Radius for 3 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. This spell has additional effects in PvP. This spell is limited to one target. This spell is limited to targets up to level 36.

20.name: Cleanse Disease
20.description: Cleanse your target, removing two Disease effects.

20.name: Cleanse Poison
20.description: Cleanse your target, removing two Poison effects.

20.name: Divine Aegis
20.description: Surround yourself with a divine aegis, granting you immunity to all incoming damage for 15 seconds. This spell can be used while stunned, incapacitated, or feared. This spell inflicts Exhausted Soul upon expiration, preventing the application of immunity effects for 30 seconds.

20.name: Restorative Smite II
20.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L10) to 10 (L20) Holy Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60), and restoring 10 (L10) to 40 (L60) Health to your group. When standing upon Consecrated ground, the health restored is increased to 30 (L10) to 120 (L60).
20.valuesSummary: 110% weapon dmg · 5–10 Holy dmg (L10–L20) · +30–300 Threat against them (L1–L60)

21.name: Crusader Strike III
21.description: Strike your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 8 (L21) to 12 (L36) Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60).
21.valuesSummary: 110% weapon dmg · 8–12 Holy dmg (L21–L36) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

22.name: Vengeful Smite II
22.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 155% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L22) to 20 (L34) Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60). The Holy damage is doubled when standing within a Consecration.
22.valuesSummary: 155% weapon dmg · 10–20 Holy dmg (L22–L34) · +30–300 Threat against them (L1–L60)

22.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
22.description: Consecrate the ground at your feet, granting allies 20% resistance to Melee damage while they remain within. Additionally, your Smite and Restorative Smite abilities will be empowered while you remain in the blessed area.

24.name: Stun
24.description: Shock your target into a daze, stunning them for 4 seconds.

24.name: Beset the Dead
24.description: Beset a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 87 Holy Damage.

24.name: Redemption
24.description: Redeem a target corpse, restoring 25% Experience. This spell inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes.

25.name: Warding Slam
25.description: Slam your target with your shield as you adopt a defensive pose, interrupting their spell casting, dealing damage to the target, and increasing your Block by 5% for the next 15s. (requires shield)

26.name: Oath of Vigilance
26.description: Guard a member of your group, reducing all damage they receive by 5% for up to 30 minutes, while transferring 50% of that damage to you. This effect may only be active on one target at a time. This effect is canceled automatically if you fall below 25% health.

28.name: Mallet of Light

30.name: Restorative Smite III

30.valuesSummary: 120% weapon dmg · 10–15 Holy dmg (L20–L30) · +30–300 Threat against them (L1–L60)

30.name: Exorcism

entries.description: Revive a target corpse, restoring 75% Experience. This spell inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes.

entries.name: Vengeful Smite V
entries.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 175% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 50 Holy Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60). The Holy damage is doubled when standing within a Consecration.

entries.name: Assail the Dead
entries.description: Assail a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 470 Holy Damage.

entries.name: Divine Spark
entries.description: Bless your target with a divine spark, increasing their maximum Health by 250 for 35 minutes.
